about: E2: the other sources crc-sdk 0.11.1 reaches, from its docs/sources/*.md and docs/data-licences.md. Hand-written; update when the pin changes.

sources.name: ERA5 reanalysis
sources.returns: Annual extremes (txx, tnn, rx1day, rx5day) fitted to curves; the per-year samples behind them
sources.coverage: Global, 1940 to the latest final month (0.25°) or 1959–2022 (1.5°)

sources.name: CMIP6 and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
sources.returns: The same four recipes from model projections, per model, scenario and member
sources.licence: Per modelling centre; NEX-GDDP is CC0 plus the model licence

sources.name: JRC EFAS and GloFAS river flood
sources.returns: Flood depth curves from return-period rasters

sources.name: NOAA ISD and GHCNh stations
sources.returns: Curves at station points; no interpolation

sources.name: ECCC IDF, daily climate, HYDAT
sources.returns: Design rainfall curves; daily observations; daily flow and level
